source: Actual local Scrum Poker UI captured with headless Playwright at a 1440 × 900 viewport at 2x device pixel ratio and encoded as lossless WebP.
content: Entirely synthetic checkout refinement session: Maya Chen facilitates Alex Rivera, Sam Taylor, and Jordan Lee. Four realistic checkout stories show one agreed estimate of 3, the second story revealed with estimates 5, 8, 5, and 3 (vote distribution, wide-spread note, full-deck score choices with vote-count badges, and Save alongside Restart in the action bar), and two queued stories. Invite team is secondary because teammates have joined, and the saved-estimate banner is no longer shown after voting begins.
capture: Recaptured 2026-11-06 from the production build. Room created and first estimate saved through the application UI; documented HTTP API used to join synthetic teammates and submit votes, with authenticated event streams maintaining live presence. The page was reloaded before capture. Desktop revealed-round spacing keeps the distribution, spread guidance, full numeric picker, Save and Restart together. No interface text or layout was altered for the capture; no real personal data or capability tokens are shown.
